0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04501_000000_ULTIMA
0.description: Is it sanctum you seek, my wayward children?<hex:02100103>Or perhaps you are come in search of power.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04501_000010_ULTIMA
1.description: That which lies at your feet─that blessed bauble─can grant you both.<hex:02100103>You need but will it so.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04501_000020_ULTIMA
2.description: Now take up your salvation and begone.<hex:02100103>Mortal agency in matters divine shall not be suffered.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04501_000100_ULTIMA
3.description: I am your mother. I am your maker! I. Am. Ivalice!<hex:02100103>Consign me unto darkness and your light will be forever lost!

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_04501_000200_SEIRYU
4.description: Prove me wrong, mortals! Make me submit─or die for your insolence!
